versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill card file (skill-card.md).
- No changes to core functionality or documentation.

Initial public release: Track, analyze, and get alerts on product prices over time.

- Track prices for products across stores and time, with category-aware insights.
- Receive alerts when a product drops significantly below its historical median price.
- Predict the best time to buy using built-in seasonal patterns for each category.
- View price history using ASCII sparklines.
- Full suite of CLI commands: add, update, remove, list products, show history, get alerts, see detailed product info, and generate reports.
- Simple, dependency-free Python script with JSON database support.
